SQL injection happens when your app builds SQL queries by concatenating user input directly into the SQL string. An attacker can then inject SQL syntax that changes the query’s meaning.

Example vulnerable code:

```python
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '" + username + "' AND password = '" + password + "'"
```
